policy.unchanged_inputs: Only exact size/SHA equality to a named frozen candidate file permits original-copy exclusion. Changed/new files in cloned repositories are retained.
policy.mathematical_binaries: All generated .bin and .sobj objects retained; no blanket binary/extension exclusion.
policy.logs: Every new/changed execution log retained outside explicitly excluded software-cache directories. Unchanged archived logs are referenced by candidate path/hash.
policy.native_tools: Only the inspected ordinary_counts compiler output is excluded; unknown native files demand review.
policy.symlinks: Aliases are recorded rather than followed; all known aliases point to an already traversed repository or declared software runtime.
policy.scope: Selection and provenance only; the top-level fresh replay establishes the arithmetic status. Transient worker streams deleted before completion cannot be recovered by this selector.
